independent_checks.accepted_baseline: The runner checks all captured accepted-G4 source hashes except the three authorized integration/documentation paths README.md, services/ifpmic_api/app.py, and services/ifpmic_api/settings.py. It also compares the protected existing AX/UI/Node and original uploaded/imported specification inventories before and after the run.
independent_checks.private_candidate_capture: The runner captures all indexed candidate sources into a mode-0600 private ZIP before testing, records its hash and entry count, validates each entry against the captured source hash, and compares current source/library/original bytes again after all phases.
independent_checks.runtime_evidence: The runner requires actual G3 and G4 runtime observations, exact G5 case markers, CLI run success, a SIGKILLed worker, and at least two successful reconcilers. For G5 it verifies unique private (pid,start_ticks) identities, private directory/log file types and modes, and actual stdout/stderr log byte counts and SHA-256 values; it omits process identities and raw output from the promoted report.
independent_checks.execution_split: Runner uses fixed separate Python inventories for 167 legacy, 91 G4 and 93 G5 cases with 300-second phase and 30-second case limits, plus the 48-case B01 Node phase at 180 seconds. The execution decision documents why the split is required.
independent_checks.whitespace_normalization: The ledger explicitly records the single trailing-LF removal after the 17-case diagnostic, pins the pre- and post-normalization SHA values, and states that no semantic/test change is claimed from that diagnostic. The frozen full 93-case gate is required on the current pinned test bytes.

remaining_gate_conditions: Run the frozen gate against these exact source and ledger bytes; the earlier focused 17-case result is diagnostic only.
Do not claim G5 acceptance unless all exact inventories and runtime/cleanup/source checks pass and independent final review accepts retained evidence.
This gate covers only the local G5 workspace prerequisite. It does not complete original AT-21 or B02, and does not establish physical power-loss or production storage guarantees.
